instruction: Underline the content text in the slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires underlining the content text. The evaluator checks if all text runs in the content shape have the underline property set to True.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks if content text is underlined by examining run.font.underline property
Postconfig properly saves the file before evaluation (Ctrl+S)
Getter correctly retrieves the PPTX file from VM using get_vm_file
Edge cases handled: missing slide, missing shape, missing text_frame, empty text
Minor issue: Underline check treats None (inherited underline) same as False (not underlined), which could cause false negatives if underlining is applied via style inheritance
Minor assumption: shape_idx=1 is assumed to be the content shape (reasonable for standard slides but not validated)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking run.font.underline == True explicitly, or handle None case by checking effective underline value
Consider validating that shape_idx=1 actually contains substantive content text (not just exists)
